products.name: Tidepool 20 Coldwater Starter Tank
products.safety_notes: Sized for a single adult Pearl-scale axolotl. Requires a chiller in rooms that exceed 68 F.

products.name: Verdant 55 Planted Aquascape System
products.safety_notes: Stand is rated for filled weight. Do not substitute a shelf; 55 gallons exceeds 500 lb filled.

products.name: Moonlace Nano Cube 5
products.safety_notes: Shrimp-safe silicone. Never dose copper-based treatments in this tank.

products.name: Banded Dune Gecko Terrarium 20
products.safety_notes: Ships with a solid liner. Do not use loose sand for animals under six months.

products.name: Ashwood Arboreal Enclosure 40
products.safety_notes: Vertical orientation only. Interior height 24 in; laying it on the long side does not meet the tree skink minimum.

products.name: Sablewing Anole Bioactive Kit
products.safety_notes: Single occupancy past six months. Sablewing anoles are territorial as adults.

products.name: Cloudtail Jerboa Deep-Burrow Habitat
products.safety_notes: Solid floor, 4 sq ft. Fill to 10 in of packable substrate; wire flooring causes sores.

products.name: Marbled Dormouse Nocturne Cage
products.safety_notes: 3 sq ft floor with branch routes. Never offer citrus to dormice.

products.name: Sootfoot Gerbil Sand Pen
products.safety_notes: Sized for a bonded pair. Sand baths only; water bathing strips the coat oils.

products.name: Halcyon Chiller Loop 200
products.safety_notes: Run on a separate thermostat. Never run dry; the pump seizes within about 90 seconds without flow.
